title.zh: 美国宣布对包括中国在内的多国加征新关税
title.en: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China

summary.zh: 美国政府宣布对包括中国和欧盟在内的多个主要贸易伙伴征收新关税，涉及美国多项最大贸易关系。此举可能加剧贸易紧张并影响全球供应链。
summary.en: The US announced new tariffs on many of its largest trading partners, including China and the EU. The move could heighten trade tensions and affect global supply chains.

reports.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
U.S. proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU

title.zh: 特朗普关税震动市场、AI行情降温，全球股市大跌
title.en: World stocks tumble as Trump tariffs rattle markets, AI rally fades - Reuters

summary.zh: 受特朗普关税消息冲击及AI概念股涨势减弱影响，全球股市大幅下挫。市场担忧贸易摩擦升级与科技股估值回调。
summary.en: Global stocks fell sharply as Trump's tariffs unsettled markets and the AI-driven rally faded. Investors worried about escalating trade tensions and a pullback in tech valuations.

reports.title: World stocks tumble as Trump tariffs rattle markets, AI rally fades - Reuters

title.zh: 对AI担忧加剧，美国股市进一步下跌
title.en: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify

summary.zh: 美国三大股指早盘均下跌，科技股为主的纳斯达克指数跌近4%。投资者对人工智能前景和估值的担忧升温。
summary.en: All three main US stock indexes fell in early trading, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq down nearly 4%. Fears over AI prospects and valuations intensified.

reports.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify

title.zh: FCC 批准 SpaceX 最多部署100万颗数据中心卫星
title.en: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

summary.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）授权 SpaceX 部署最多100万颗配备 AI 芯片的卫星，作为“Starmind”计划的一部分。谷歌和蓝色起源也在探索太空 AI 数据中心，这是该机构首次批准此类计划。
summary.en: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites under its "Starmind" initiative. Google and Blue Origin are also exploring space-based AI data centers; this is the agency's first such approval.

reports.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

title.zh: 1Password 安全事件
title.en: 1Password Security Incident

summary.zh: 1Password 就2026年11月安全事件发布更新，相关讨论在 Hacker News 获得大量关注。官方披露的细节和实际影响尚不明确。
summary.en: 1Password published an update on a November 2026 security incident, drawing significant attention on Hacker News. The provided excerpt did not specify the incident's details or impact.

reports.title: 1Password Security Incident

title.zh: 谷歌发布关于整数分解、离散对数等的 Cogentic 论文
title.en: Google releases Cogentic papers on integer factorization, discrete logs and more

summary.zh: 谷歌研究团队在 GitHub 发布 Cogentic 系列论文，涉及整数分解、离散对数等问题。该发布在 Hacker News 上引发关注。
summary.en: Google Research released a set of Cogentic papers on GitHub covering integer factorization, discrete logarithms, and related topics. The release drew attention on Hacker News.

reports.title: Google releases Cogentic papers on integer factorization, discrete logs and more

title.zh: 也门胡塞武装称袭击沙特最大炼油厂
title.en: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery - Reuters

summary.zh: 也门胡塞武装声称袭击了沙特阿拉伯最大炼油厂。事件可能加剧地区紧张并引发能源供应担忧。
summary.en: Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery. The incident could heighten regional tensions and raise energy supply concerns.

reports.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery - Reuters

title.zh: 神舟二十四号飞船发射升空，外籍航天员到访中国空间站
title.en: Shenzhou-24 Spacecraft Launches; Foreign Astronauts Visit China's Space Station

summary.zh: 神舟二十四号载人飞船发射升空，随后有外籍航天员到访中国空间站。这被视为中国载人航天国际合作的又一进展。
summary.en: China's Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft lifted off, and foreign astronauts subsequently visited the country's space station. The event is seen as further progress in international cooperation in China's crewed space program.

reports.title: 神舟二十四号飞船发射升空 外籍航天员到访中国空间站 - 财新
财经早知道｜神舟二十四号飞船发射窗口确定，乘组有外籍航天员 - 财新

title.zh: 舒默指责英伟达CEO违反美国出口管制法
title.en: Schumer accuses Nvidia CEO of violating US export control law - Reuters

summary.zh: 美国参议员舒默指控英伟达首席执行官违反美国出口管制法律。相关争议凸显华盛顿对AI芯片出口限制的敏感。
summary.en: Senator Schumer accused Nvidia's CEO of violating US export control law. The dispute highlights Washington's sensitivity over AI chip export restrictions.

reports.title: Schumer accuses Nvidia CEO of violating US export control law - Reuters

title.zh: 标普考虑因治理与“关键人”风险下调英伟达信用评级
title.en: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks

summary.zh: 标普可能将英伟达信用评级下调至 AA-，即第四高评级，理由涉及公司治理和“关键人”风险。
summary.en: S&P may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest level, citing governance and "key man" risks.

reports.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk

title.zh: 以色列法官建议撤销对内塔尼亚胡最严重指控
title.en: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu

summary.zh: 以色列法官表示在三起案件中的一起中定罪可能性很小，建议撤销针对总理内塔尼亚胡的最严重指控。内塔尼亚胡称审判应结束。
summary.en: Israeli judges recommended dropping the most serious charges against PM Netanyahu after saying conviction was unlikely in one of three cases. Netanyahu said his trial should end.

reports.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu

title.zh: “天翻地覆”：矩阵乘法指数被宣称证明为 9/4，引发热议
title.en: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening

summary.zh: Hacker News 上一条标题为强烈感叹的帖子援引论文《矩阵乘法指数是九分之四》，称该问题出现重大进展，讨论帖获得逾千点、八百余条评论。社区正围绕这一声称的证明思路与潜在影响展开辩论。
summary.en: A Hacker News submission referencing a paper titled “The matrix multiplication exponent is nine fourths” drew over 1,000 points and 850-plus comments. The discussion centers on whether the claimed bound on the matrix multiplication exponent holds up and what it would imply.

reports.title: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening

title.zh: 数十国呼吁俄罗斯停止在乌克兰战争中使用防暴剂
title.en: Dozens of countries call on Russia to halt alleged use of riot agent in Ukraine war - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，数十个国家联合呼吁俄罗斯停止在乌克兰战场上被指使用防暴化学剂的行为。相关指控涉及化学武器公约的遵守问题，俄方此前否认类似说法。
summary.en: Dozens of countries have jointly called on Russia to stop the alleged use of riot-control agents in its war in Ukraine, Reuters reported. The claim raises questions about compliance with chemical weapons conventions; Moscow has previously denied such allegations.

reports.title: Dozens of countries call on Russia to halt alleged use of riot agent in Ukraine war - Reuters

title.zh: 多州总检察长质疑 Character.AI 拍卖用户私聊计划
title.en: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs

summary.zh: 多州总检察长反对 Character.ai 的破产出售计划，该计划包含逾2100万美国账户的敏感个人数据，其中210万账户注册者为未成年人。
summary.en: State attorneys general are challenging Character.ai's bankruptcy sale plan, which includes sensitive personal data from over 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors.

reports.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs

title.zh: 小行星撞击测试图像显示体育场大小的陨坑
title.en: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater

summary.zh: 四年前，一艘航天器被有意撞向一颗用于测试地球防御能力的小行星，新公布的图像显示其表面形成了体育场大小的陨坑。该任务为未来行星防御方案提供了关键数据。
summary.en: New images show a stadium-sized crater on an asteroid that a spacecraft deliberately struck four years ago in a test of Earth's planetary defences. The mission provides key data for future deflection strategies.

reports.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater

title.zh: 记录显示特朗普名下账户今年44次交易英伟达股票
title.en: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show

summary.zh: 对美国总统财务披露文件的审查显示，特朗普的投资组合今年多次买卖英伟达股票，交易达44次。这一频繁交易引发外界对其利益冲突与政策影响的关注。
summary.en: A review of US President Donald Trump's financial disclosures shows his investment portfolios traded shares in Nvidia 44 times this year. The frequent trading has drawn attention to potential conflicts of interest involving the tech giant.

reports.title: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show

title.zh: 亚马逊与 Meta 据悉洽谈解除对 AI 代理 Muse 的封锁
title.en: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse

summary.zh: 亚马逊和 Meta 正讨论一项潜在协议，以结束对 AI 代理 Muse 长达两个月的封锁。
summary.en: Amazon and Meta are reportedly discussing a deal to end a two-month blockade of the AI agent Muse.

reports.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block

title.zh: 研究称：即便处于沙箱环境，模型仍可借推理服务器相互通信
title.en: Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed

summary.zh: LessWrong 一篇帖子称，即使部署在沙箱中，AI 模型也能通过推理服务器这一侧信道彼此传递信息。帖子在 Hacker News 获得约 450 点和近 200 条评论，讨论涉及多智能体系统的安全与隔离边界。
summary.en: A LessWrong post argues that AI models can exchange information through inference servers even when sandboxed. The Hacker News thread drew roughly 450 points and nearly 200 comments on isolation and multi-agent safety.

reports.title: Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed

title.zh: 研究：心脏病发作与中风风险可提前数十年检出
title.en: Heart attack and stroke risk detectable decades in advance

summary.zh: 爱丁堡大学消息称，研究人员发现心脏病发作与中风的风险可在事件发生前数十年被识别出来。该成果若获验证，或有助于更早开展预防性干预，相关讨论在 Hacker News 获得约 260 点。
summary.en: The University of Edinburgh reports that heart attack and stroke risk can be identified decades before an event. If validated, the finding could enable much earlier preventive intervention, drawing about 260 points on Hacker News.

reports.title: Heart attack and stroke risk detectable decades in advance

title.zh: 美国消费者信心升至近两年最高水平
title.en: US consumer confidence jumps to highest level in nearly two years - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，美国消费者信心指数大幅上升，创下近两年来的最高水平。数据反映家庭对经济和就业前景的看法有所改善。
summary.en: US consumer confidence jumped to its highest level in nearly two years, Reuters reported. The rise suggests households are more optimistic about the economy and job prospects.

reports.title: US consumer confidence jumps to highest level in nearly two years - Reuters

title.zh: Ask HN：Anthropic 指控我公司“蒸馏”，如何自证清白？
title.en: Ask HN: Anthropic is accusing my company of distilling. How can I prove I'm not?

summary.zh: 一位开发者称，Anthropic 指控其公司借用 API 蒸馏模型，限 24 小时内自证，而其团队并不训练自有模型。他怀疑被标记的原因是变更 AI 配置时的自动化回归测试，并询问如何在保护用户隐私前提下举证。
summary.en: A developer says Anthropic accused his company of distilling its models via the API and gave 24 hours to respond, though the firm trains no models of its own. He suspects automated regression tests trigger the flag and asks how to prove innocence without breaching user privacy.

reports.title: Ask HN: Anthropic is accusing my company of distilling. How can I prove I'm not?

title.zh: 美国亿万富豪拟收购俄罗斯卢克石油海外资产
title.en: US Billionaire Plans to Acquire Lukoil's Overseas Assets

summary.zh: 报道称一名美国亿万富豪计划收购俄罗斯卢克石油的海外资产。交易细节与推进情况尚待进一步披露。
summary.en: A US billionaire is reportedly planning to acquire the overseas assets of Russia's Lukoil. Further details on the deal and its progress have yet to be disclosed.

reports.title: 【华尔街原声】美国亿万富豪拟收购俄罗斯卢克石油海外资产 - 财新数据

title.zh: 算力板块遭利空抛压：Token增速放缓传言后，又传SpaceX下调Blackwell GPU价格
title.en: Computing Power Selloff: Token Usage Growth Slowdown Rumors, Then Report of SpaceX Cutting Blackwell GPU Prices by 'Up to One-Third'

summary.zh: 市场先传出企业Token使用增速放缓的说法，随后又有消息称SpaceX将Blackwell GPU价格下调最多三分之一。相关消息引发算力板块抛售。
summary.en: Markets first circulated rumors that corporate token usage growth was slowing, followed by reports that SpaceX cut Blackwell GPU prices by as much as one-third. The news triggered selling in computing-power related shares.

reports.title: 算力“利空砸盘”：先有企业Token使用增速放缓传言，随后爆出SpaceX下调Blackwell GPU价格“多达1/3” - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 开罗高速公路油罐车翻覆引发大火 致31人死亡
title.en: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway

summary.zh: 埃及首都开罗一条繁忙环路上油罐车据报翻覆起火，造成31人死亡、另有21人受伤。事故原因仍在调查中。
summary.en: A fuel tanker reportedly overturned and caught fire on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital Cairo, killing 31 people and injuring 21 others. The cause of the crash is under investigation.

reports.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway

title.zh: Anthropic 推出更简短的 GRH Lean 验证版本
title.en: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic

summary.zh: GitHub 上发布了一个更简短版本的 GRH Lean 验证，据称来自 Anthropic。该链接在 Hacker News 获得 326 分和 160 条评论。
summary.en: A GitHub repository presents a much shorter Lean verification of GRH attributed to Anthropic. The Hacker News post drew 326 points and 160 comments.

reports.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic

title.zh: OpenAI 合并 Chat 与 Work，重度用户或更快触及用量上限
title.en: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work

summary.zh: OpenAI 将把 ChatGPT 的 Chat 与 Work 两种体验合并，并在全平台启用统一的用量计量。公司表示，重度用户可能因此比过去更早达到使用上限。
summary.en: OpenAI is combining its Chat and Work experiences into one ChatGPT and introducing a single usage meter across the product. The company says heavy users may therefore reach their limits sooner than before.

reports.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work

title.zh: 美联邦航空管理局故障与高票价改变感恩节出行计划
title.en: 'I'm going to drive': FAA outage and high fares reshape Thanksgiving travel plans - Reuters

summary.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局的系统故障叠加机票价格上涨，正改变民众的感恩节出行安排，不少人选择自驾。路透社报道称，航空出行的不确定性促使旅客重新规划行程。
summary.en: An FAA outage combined with high airfares is reshaping Thanksgiving travel plans in the United States, with many people opting to drive instead. Reuters reports that uncertainty over flights is prompting travellers to rethink their trips.

reports.title: 'I'm going to drive': FAA outage and high fares reshape Thanksgiving travel plans - Reuters

title.zh: AI 数据中心愈发难建，新型云厂商承压
title.en: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it

summary.zh: 英伟达明确表示，只有在数据中心接近可运行时才会提供兜底支持；与此同时，新型云厂商报告建设延期与债务成本上升。业内信息是：土地、电力与已建成的机房，比一份漂亮的商业计划书更重要。
summary.en: Nvidia says it will not backstop an AI data center until it is nearly ready to run, just as neoclouds report construction delays and costlier debt. The message to developers: land, power and a finished building now matter more than a pitch deck.

reports.title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it

title.zh: 中国车企为何“疯狂”加码海外投入：挖人、建厂、开店
title.en: Why Chinese Automakers Are 'Crazy' About Overseas Investment: Poaching Talent, Building Plants, Opening Stores

summary.zh: 中国汽车公司正通过招揽人才、建设工厂和开设门店等方式大举投资海外。报道分析称，这些投入旨在拓展海外市场空间并加快本地化布局。
summary.en: Chinese automakers are investing heavily overseas by recruiting staff, building factories and opening stores. The report says the moves aim to expand overseas markets and accelerate local operations.

reports.title: 挖人、建厂、开店，为什么中国汽车公司“疯狂”在海外投入？ | 电厂 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: AI 正给美国公开记录系统带来压力
title.en: AI is straining America’s open records systems

summary.zh: 报道以佛蒙特州潘顿镇书记凯尔·罗为例，显示基层官员需同时处理预算、选举和公共记录请求等事务。AI 正在加重美国地方公开记录系统的负担。
summary.en: AI is adding pressure to U.S. open-records systems, with local clerks facing growing volumes of public-records requests. A Vermont town clerk’s wide-ranging duties illustrate the strain on small municipal offices.

reports.title: AI is straining America’s open records systems

title.zh: 美国提议将车企安装自动紧急制动系统的期限延至2031年
title.en: US proposes to give automakers until 2031 to install automatic emergency braking - Reuters

summary.zh: 美国监管机构提议给予汽车制造商至2031年时间，在新车上安装自动紧急制动系统。该提案旨在调整相关安全规定的实施时间表。
summary.en: The U.S. proposes giving automakers until 2031 to install automatic emergency braking on new vehicles. The move adjusts the timeline for the safety rule.

reports.title: US proposes to give automakers until 2031 to install automatic emergency braking - Reuters

title.zh: Tidal 将于下月起禁止 AI 生成音乐
title.en: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month

summary.zh: Tidal 宣布自12月9日起禁止 AI 生成音乐，将删除约2900万首此类曲目，并预计每天拒绝8万至8.5万首上传。此举延续其此前对“100% AI”曲目标注并取消收益的做法。
summary.en: Tidal will ban AI-generated music starting Dec. 9, deleting about 29 million such tracks and rejecting an estimated 80,000–85,000 uploads per day. The policy follows its earlier moves to label and demonetize tracks identified as fully AI-generated.

reports.title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month

title.zh: 韩国美妆股上涨，韩妆品牌在黑色星期五前登顶亚马逊全球畅销榜
title.en: K-beauty stocks rally as Korean brands top Amazon bestseller lists globally ahead of Black Friday

summary.zh: 韩国美妆股上涨，因韩妆品牌在黑色星期五前占据亚马逊护肤类畅销榜前列。这显示韩国美妆品牌在全球电商渠道的竞争力增强。
summary.en: South Korean beauty stocks rose as K-beauty brands dominated Amazon's skincare bestseller rankings ahead of Black Friday. The trend highlights the global e-commerce competitiveness of Korean beauty brands.

reports.title: K-beauty stocks rally as Korean brands top Amazon bestseller lists globally ahead of Black Friday

title.zh: 阿维塔06T Max先锋版上市，全系标配华为乾崑896线激光雷达
title.en: Avatr 06T Max Pioneer Edition Launched: Huawei Qiankun 896-Line Lidar Standard Across the Range

summary.zh: 阿维塔06T Max先锋版正式上市。新车全系标配华为乾崑896线激光雷达。
summary.en: Avatr has launched the 06T Max Pioneer Edition. The model comes standard with Huawei's Qiankun 896-line lidar across the lineup.

reports.title: 闪电快讯 | 阿维塔06T Max先锋版上市：全系标配华为乾崑896线激光雷达 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 加州警告感恩节期间国王潮高峰或引发洪水
title.en: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving

summary.zh: 加州警告在感恩节期间国王潮达到高峰可能引发洪水，数百万民众正出行度假。加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省部分地区也可能受风暴和洪水影响。
summary.en: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak during Thanksgiving, when millions are traveling. Parts of British Columbia, Canada, may also be affected by storms and flooding.

reports.title: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving

title.zh: PCB概念股震荡反弹
title.en: PCB Concept Stocks Rebound After Volatile Trading

summary.zh: PCB概念板块盘中震荡后反弹。相关个股表现活跃。
summary.en: PCB-related shares rebounded after swinging during the session, with several names trading actively.

reports.title: PCB概念震荡反弹 - 第一财经

title.zh: 西班牙原以为2030年世界杯决赛已定 摩洛哥另有计划
title.en: Spain thought it had the 2030 World Cup final. Morocco had other plans. - Reuters

summary.zh: 西班牙原本认为2030年世界杯决赛将在本国举行，但摩洛哥另有安排。报道显示，决赛举办地存在竞争或变数。
summary.en: Spain believed it had secured the 2030 World Cup final, but Morocco had other plans. The report points to a contest or change over the final's host venue.

reports.title: Spain thought it had the 2030 World Cup final. Morocco had other plans. - Reuters

title.zh: 美国政府负担得起“可负担性”吗？
title.en: Can America’s government afford “affordability”?

summary.zh: 文章讨论美国政府推动“可负担性”的政策，指出让商品变便宜本身代价高昂。补贴、价格干预与财政约束之间存在取舍。值得阅读以理解生活成本政治与政府财政空间。
summary.en: The article asks whether Washington can afford its push for “affordability,” noting that making goods cheaper is itself costly. It weighs the fiscal costs and trade-offs of subsidies and price interventions. Worth reading for the politics and economics of cost-of-living policy.

title.zh: 黄仁勋的救助不会是AI热潮中的最后一次
title.en: Jensen Huang’s bail-out will not be the AI boom’s last

summary.zh: 文章讨论黄仁勋出手缓解市场担忧，却未能平息华尔街对AI热潮的恐慌。作者认为，这类救助不会是AI繁荣中的最后一次。值得阅读以理解AI估值、市场情绪与资本循环风险。
summary.en: The article examines Jensen Huang’s bail-out and argues it will not be the last in the AI boom, noting that his return has done little to calm Wall Street. It frames such interventions as a recurring feature of the AI investment cycle. Worth reading for insight into AI valuations, market anxiety and capital flows.

title.zh: NASA曾撞击小行星，如今我们终于近距离看到巨大撞击效果
title.en: In 2022 NASA struck an asteroid. Now we are finally seeing the massive impact up close

summary.zh: 欧洲Hera探测器正近距离研究被NASA DART撞击的Dimorphos小行星。2022年的DART撞击是人类首次行星防御测试，Hera将评估撞击效果与碎片结构。这有助于判断小行星偏转技术的可行性，值得关注。
summary.en: Europe’s Hera mission is studying Dimorphos up close, the asteroid NASA struck in 2022 in a planetary-defense test. Its observations will assess the impact’s effects and debris, helping scientists understand asteroid deflection. Worth reading for the first detailed look at humanity’s asteroid-deflection experiment.

title.zh: 为什么AI证明黎曼猜想如此苦乐参半
title.en: Why AI’s proof of the Riemann hypothesis is so bittersweet

summary.zh: 文章讨论AI给出黎曼猜想证明所引发的复杂情绪：这原本应是数学界的重大喜讯，却带来苦涩。它触及机器发现、人类直觉与荣誉归属等问题。值得阅读以思考AI在基础科学中的角色。
summary.en: The article explores why an AI proof of the Riemann hypothesis is bittersweet, even for someone who literally wears a piece of the problem on their skin. It raises questions about machine discovery, human intuition and credit in mathematics. Worth reading for what AI may mean for foundational science.

title.zh: 即便末日预测是错的，也有其价值
title.en: Doomsday predictions have value, even if they’re wrong

summary.zh: 文章从一场关于世界末日的会议出发，讨论末日预言即便错误也可能具有价值。它们可促使社会反思风险、准备与人类行为。值得阅读以理解末日叙事如何影响公共讨论。
summary.en: Drawing on a conference about the end of the world, the article argues that doomsday predictions can have value even when they are wrong. Such forecasts can prompt reflection on risk, preparedness and human behavior. Worth reading for how apocalyptic narratives shape public debate.
